name: Convivial Enricher
description: Enrich user profiles with data from external sources.
project_description: The Enricher module provides automatic progressive profiling by enabling enrichment of a visitor's profile from varied backend datasources. It defines an 'enricher' config entity that publishes a public endpoint path; when a visitor arrives on that path carrying a token (for example the unique identifier embedded in an email campaign link), the module hands the token to each configured datasource plugin, which reaches back into an external service (ActiveCampaign, Mailchimp, Recombee, or a custom plugin), retrieves data for that contact, and writes the allow-listed values into browser cookies (prefixed 'convivial_enricher_') before redirecting the visitor to the requested return-to URL. Downstream profile tools such as Basil then read those cookies client-side to personalise the experience. Datasource plugins are pluggable via the EnricherDatasource plugin type; a Dummy datasource ships for testing and three integration submodules (ActiveCampaign, Mailchimp, Recombee) are packaged with the project. Maintained by Morpht.
